title: ctenopteris hayatae
intro: Ctenopteris hayatae, commonly known as Japanese fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in East Asian medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ctenopteris hayatae include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and improving immune function.
